title: is being done has been done (passive 2)
summary: Пассив в present continuous (**is being done** — делается сейчас) и в present perfect (**has been done** — уже сделано).
ru:
## Два новых пассивных времени
В юните 21 мы учили пассив в простом настоящем и прошедшем. Теперь добавим:
- **is / are being + причастие** — действие происходит **сейчас**
- **has / have been + причастие** — действие **уже произошло** (результат виден сейчас)

## is / are being done — делается сейчас
> Somebody is repairing my car. (актив)
> My car **is being repaired**. — Мою машину сейчас ремонтируют. (пассив)
> New houses **are being built** near the park. — Рядом с парком строят новые дома.
> The room **is being cleaned** at the moment. — В комнате сейчас убирают.

## has / have been done — уже сделано
> Somebody has stolen my keys. (актив)
> My keys **have been stolen**. — Мои ключи украли. (пассив)
> The door **has been painted**. — Дверь покрасили.
> I'm not going to the party. I **haven't been invited**. — Я не иду на вечеринку: меня не пригласили.
> **Has** this shirt **been washed**? — Эту рубашку уже постирали?

## Сравнение времён
| Время | Пример |
|---|---|
| present simple | The office **is cleaned** every day. (всегда) |
| present continuous | The office **is being cleaned** now. (сейчас) |
| present perfect | The office **has been cleaned**. (уже, результат) |
| past simple | The office **was cleaned** yesterday. (вчера) |

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~My car is repairing.~~ → My car **is being repaired**. (пассив, не актив)
- ~~My keys have stolen.~~ → My keys **have been stolen**. (нужно been)
- ~~The room has been cleaned yesterday.~~ → The room **was cleaned** yesterday. (с законченным временем — past simple)
en:
## Two more passive forms
In Unit 21 we practised the present simple and past simple passive. Now we add:
- **is / are being + past participle** = the action is happening **now**
- **has / have been + past participle** = the action **has finished** (the result is important now)

## is / are being done
> Somebody is repairing my car. (active)
> My car **is being repaired**. (passive)
> New houses **are being built** near the park.
> The room **is being cleaned** at the moment.

## has / have been done
> Somebody has stolen my keys. (active)
> My keys **have been stolen**. (passive)
> The door **has been painted**.
> I'm not going to the party. I **haven't been invited**.
> **Has** this shirt **been washed**?

## Compare
| Tense | Example |
|---|---|
| present simple | The office **is cleaned** every day. |
| present continuous | The office **is being cleaned** now. |
| present perfect | The office **has been cleaned**. |
| past simple | The office **was cleaned** yesterday. |

## Common mistakes
- ~~My car is repairing.~~ → My car **is being repaired**.
- ~~My keys have stolen.~~ → My keys **have been stolen**.
- ~~The room has been cleaned yesterday.~~ → The room **was cleaned** yesterday.
structure:
## Present continuous passive
| Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|
| The car is being repaired. | The car isn't being repaired. | Is the car being repaired? |
| The cars are being repaired. | The cars aren't being repaired. | Are the cars being repaired? |
| I am being followed. | I'm not being followed. | Am I being followed? |

## Present perfect passive
| Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|
| My key has been stolen. | My key hasn't been stolen. | Has my key been stolen? |
| My keys have been stolen. | My keys haven't been stolen. | Have my keys been stolen? |

## Формулы
> **am / is / are + being + past participle** — сейчас
> **have / has + been + past participle** — уже сделано

## Краткие ответы
- Is it being repaired? — Yes, it **is**. / No, it **isn't**.
- Has it been repaired? — Yes, it **has**. / No, it **hasn't**.

exercises.title: Что происходит сейчас?
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в present continuous passive (is / are being + причастие).
exercises.example: (the car / repair) → The car is being repaired.

items.text: The windows {{are being cleaned|'re being cleaned}} at the moment.
A new bridge {{is being built|'s being built}} near our school.
The dinner {{is being cooked|'s being cooked}} now.
My shirts {{are being ironed|'re being ironed}} today.
The grass {{is being cut|'s being cut}} right now.
Our house {{is being painted|'s being painted}} this week.

exercises.title: Что уже произошло?
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в present perfect passive (has / have been + причастие).

items.text: My bike {{has been stolen|'s been stolen}}.
The rooms {{have been cleaned|'ve been cleaned}}.
The letter {{has been sent|'s been sent}}.
The windows {{haven't been washed|have not been washed}} yet.

items.q: My car isn't here. It ___ at the garage right now.
I can't find my phone. I think it ___.
Many new roads ___ in this city now.
Your room ___ . You can go in.

items.prompt: Что сейчас строят или ремонтируют в вашем районе?

items.prompt: Что уже сделано в вашем доме на этой неделе?

items.sample: The kitchen hasn't been painted yet.

items.prompt: Что сейчас делают в вашем офисе или школе?
